items.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: I forget who the leader was but it was based on Glenn Miller — it was the Glenn Miller band actually. But they played all the other big bands.

ctx.x: There’s a lot of young talent out there. © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

There’s a lot of young and really good talent. I mean these kinds are just, they’re on the money you know. They’ve really got some talent. And it would be just so wonderful if they had a place to really let it out you know, in the right way you know. Because it’s not always in the book. It’s not always in the studio. You see what I mean? It’s not always, see what made the Joe Williams and Buddy Riches, the Jo Jones and Gene Krupa, they had a whole spectrum of outlets. They had the dances, you know, they had the…
That’s interesting. A lot of people have said that. I don’t know, sometimes when an art form comes from somewhere else, people treat it with more respect.
